image_description: A side-profile view of a Common Wombat standing on rocky ground near the entrance of a burrow. The animal has a stocky, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse, greyish-brown fur. Its head is broad and blunt with small eyes and rounded ears. Short, powerful limbs are visible, supporting its low center of gravity. The background consists of dark earth/rock and some green vegetation.
